prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / view derivation. Asset: consistent THREE-VIEW design sheet of the exact COMPLETE HUMANOID CORE MECHA in the reference. One wide landscape canvas, three full-height views in a row: FRONT on the left, exact LEFT PROFILE facing image-left in the middle, BACK on the right. Same standing height, neutral relaxed symmetrical stance, fists closed beside thighs, same head-to-body proportions and identical armor identity in every view. Use orthographic-looking design drawing projection, no perspective three-quarter view. Ivory plain background, subtle thin horizontal alignment guides for head/shoulder/pelvis/knee/sole only, no text or frame. Do not replace this with three different pose illustrations.

Keep reference identity precisely: complete slender athletic orange/ivory humanoid robot, silver face and white helmet with TWO orange upward side horns and cyan forehead/eyes, long layered orange-and-ivory mechanical mane attached behind the head; angular ivory chest, orange shoulder plates, graphite abdomen/joints; TWO heavy orange forearm shock sleeves each with one cyan ring and an oversized blocky white-knuckle fist; white upper legs, orange knee pads without drills, segmented white shin armor with orange side structure, separate articulated ankles and white/orange feet. Strong inked clean KINETIC_CEL cel shading. This is the complete independent core BEFORE external combination. Do not add bomber wings or backpack tail fins, train shells, tank treads, knee drills, cannons, extra limbs or a new chest emblem. Preserve both complete legs and both arms. In profile show the orange shock sleeve in side profile, not a front-facing circular disk; wrist and closed fist ahead of elbow in the relaxed arm. The long mane remains behind the head and back, never in front of the face/chest; back view can naturally show the mane covering upper back, without inventing a different backpack. At the back legs show the same ankle hinges, heel structure and segmented calf backs, not blank cylinders. All three views depict the same core, armor segmentation and limb proportions; both fists remain equally substantial. High clarity production concept sheet, not a photographic render or a finished 3D model.
